title: Satori business app form
description: Writes a version 2 form for a document type, its Edit or Create form, one card per schema, from the server's content model, and has the package's component contribute it.

package.description: The app definition package, as a path from the workspace root, such as business-apps/packages/acme-contracts.

type.description: The document type the form is for, as the content model names it.

mode.description: edit, the Edit form, or create, the Create form for a new record of the type.

model.description: The content model, a file `npm run app-package:model` exported: { doctypes, facets, schemas }. Give this or modelServer.

modelServer.description: Read the content model live instead, from this Nuxeo, such as http://localhost:8080/nuxeo, with NUXEO_USER and NUXEO_PASS from the environment. HTTPS, or HTTP to this machine only.

schemas.description: The schemas to edit, one card each, in order, separated by commas. Defaults to the type's schemas but Nuxeo's own (common, dublincore, uid, file, files, facetedTag, relatedtext).

required.description: The fields required whenever they are editable, <prefix>:<name> each, separated by commas. Each must be one the form lists.

title.description: Open the first card with dc:title, the record's name, when the type has Dublin Core and schemas does not name it: a form draws only the fields it lists.

force.description: Write the form again from the model if the type already has one in this mode: edits made to it by hand are lost. Its labels keep the text labels/en.json has.
